key_messages.value: Confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms. Humor allowed; sarcasm about competitors is not.
key_messages.anchor: Confident, modern Greek with natural use of English category terms. Humor allowed;

mandatories.value: The product name Meltemi Fizz is always written in Latin script, in full. Never transliterated, never abbreviated to "Fizz".
mandatories.anchor: The product name **Meltemi Fizz** is always written in Latin script, in full.

mandatories.value: Logo clear space: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides.
mandatories.anchor: Logo clear space: minimum 1× the height of the wordmark on all sides.

mandatories.value: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518. Backgrounds must not use gradients over photography.
mandatories.anchor: Primary palette: Aegean Blue #1B4F8A, Citrus Yellow #F5C518.

mandatories.value: Permitted claims: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list).
mandatories.anchor: Permitted: "zero sugar", "φυσικά συστατικά" (per approved ingredient list).

mandatories.value: Not permitted: any health or weight-loss claim; any comparison naming a competitor brand.
mandatories.anchor: **Not permitted:** any health or weight-loss claim; any comparison naming a competitor brand.

mandatories.value: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding).
mandatories.anchor: No alcohol association of any kind (imagery, occasions, co-branding).

mandatories.value: Avoid generic "beach party" clichés; the brand leans premium-everyday, not spring break.
mandatories.anchor: Avoid generic "beach party" clichés; the brand leans premium-everyday, not spring break.
